title: Anthropic Rewrites Messages API in Rust Without Human Developers to Cut CPU Use 40% to 50%
summary:
The Messages API powering the AI startup's services recently underwent a transition to the Rust programming language to improve its computational performance. To execute the migration, Anthropic used its Claude AI model to generate the source code based on architectural plans created by human engineers, as the team had no human Rust specialists on staff.

The transition reduced the API's CPU usage by 40% to 50% while maintaining performance parity with the previous version through testing against live traffic. The successful overhaul challenges the traditional software engineering caution against conducting large scale rewrites of production systems due to high failure risks.
